package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	kinds "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/decl/components/kinds"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/kinds"
	"github.com/orbit-z/orbit"
)

func main() {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := kinds.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&buf), kinds.Props{}, orbit.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Print(buf.String())
}
